name: Who's Home
description: A shared family status board. Each member sets whether they're home, away, busy, or do-not-disturb — with an optional note and a "back by" time. Everyone sees the board at a glance, on the home screen and on the kiosk.

set_status.title: Set a member's status on the board
set_status.description: Update someone's presence when another app's event says where they are — an approved late night, a scheduled absence.

suggested_automations.title: Mark someone home when they arrive at the home zone
suggested_automations.description: A safe-zone arrival sets that member to home, so the board reflects who is actually in rather than who last remembered to tap a button. The filter keeps it to the home zone — arriving at school is not being home.

suggested_automations.title: Mark someone away when they leave the home zone
suggested_automations.description: Leaving the home zone flips the board to away. Paired with the arrival rule, presence maintains itself.

suggested_automations.title: Show an approved late night on the board
suggested_automations.description: When a curfew exception is approved, mark that member away with the date they're due back, so the board and Today both show it without anyone updating it by hand.

source.query: SELECT member_name AS title, CASE status WHEN 'away' THEN 'Away' WHEN 'busy' THEN 'Busy' WHEN 'dnd' THEN 'Do not disturb' ELSE 'Home' END AS subtitle, updated_at AS at FROM app_status_board__statuses WHERE status != 'home' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT member_id AS id, member_name AS title, CASE WHEN back_time = '' THEN back_date ELSE back_date || 'T' || back_time END AS when_at, CASE WHEN note != '' THEN note ELSE 'Back home' END AS subtitle, member_id AS member_id FROM app_status_board__statuses WHERE status != 'home' AND back_date = :today ORDER BY back_time LIMIT 20
